mechanics.mechanic: Open by defining the broad topic, its relevance to everyday goals, and the practical value of understanding it.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when introducing a complex subject that could otherwise feel abstract or specialized.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid promising universal results or implying that one explanation will solve every related problem.

mechanics.mechanic: Distinguish between memorizing procedures and understanding the underlying mechanism, then use that distinction to justify the episode’s structure.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when teaching adaptable skills rather than fixed instructions.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid treating mechanistic understanding as automatically sufficient for safe or effective application.

mechanics.mechanic: Present a small set of foundational categories beneath many seemingly unrelated examples, then organize the explanation around those categories.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when the audience faces a large, confusing field of options or terminology.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid oversimplifying by implying that every outcome has only one cause or belongs to only one category.

mechanics.function: Build from basic units to systems
mechanics.mechanic: Explain the smallest relevant components first, show how they interact, and then connect those interactions to larger patterns, experiences, or behaviors.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use for scientific, technical, or systems-oriented explanations.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid introducing advanced labels before the audience understands the basic relationship being described.

mechanics.mechanic: Introduce an accessible analogy to make an invisible process intuitive, then clarify where the analogy stops being exact.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when the mechanism involves microscopic, abstract, or counterintuitive processes.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid allowing the analogy to replace the actual explanation or imply a one-to-one correspondence.

mechanics.function: Separate timescales and layers of action
mechanics.mechanic: Distinguish rapid effects from slower background effects, and explain how the background condition changes the impact of an immediate intervention.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when outcomes depend on both short-term triggers and longer-term context.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid presenting baseline conditions as fixed, uniform, or equally relevant in every situation.

mechanics.mechanic: State the main finding, identify the study design or evidence basis, note meaningful limitations, and then translate the result into a bounded practical implication.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when moving from research findings to recommendations or real-world applications.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid treating a single study, correlation, or combined intervention as proof that each individual component causes the full outcome.

mechanics.mechanic: Acknowledge common exceptions, alternative interpretations, or opposing cases, then explain why the central framework still applies within defined conditions.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when the audience is likely to identify legitimate edge cases or conflicting experiences.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid dismissing exceptions, caricaturing disagreement, or using caveats so extensively that the main point disappears.

mechanics.function: Convert explanation into a decision rule
mechanics.mechanic: After describing the mechanism, connect the relevant variables to a practical choice: identify the goal, assess the current context, select an intervention, and adjust its intensity or timing.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when the audience needs to apply principles flexibly rather than follow a rigid checklist.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid presenting context-sensitive guidance as a guaranteed formula or ignoring individual constraints.

mechanics.mechanic: Briefly restate the central categories and their relationships at transition points, using the recap to prepare the audience for the next level of detail.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use in long explanations with multiple terms, phases, or interacting systems.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid repeating earlier material without adding orientation, contrast, or a clearer application.
